messages:
jordan: Quick sync — we need to lock the 'catalog onramp' acceptance criteria for new models. I sketched a minimal list: eval harness pass, customer smoke opt-in, perf targets, and clear rollback triggers. Can we confirm what’s mandatory vs optional?

maya: +1. I think mandatory should be: eval pass, basic perf SLOs, and a migration/rollback plan. Customer smoke can be opt-in but needs a clear opt-out path.

samir: Fwiw, ops perspective — also need an infra fingerprint: memory/kv cache usage and any non-default kernel requirements documented. Those break private deploys unexpectedly.

kevin: For benchmarks, propose we use the new onramp harness (v2) and a short, reproducible script customers can run. Example thresholds:
```
- eval: >= 78% on core prompt set (task-weighted)
- hallucination delta <= 4% vs baseline
- latency p95 <= 300ms on medium pool (seq=1024)
- tail mem < 18GB per replica
```
If any of these fail, model doesn’t pass onramp.

anas: One nuance: different workloads have different cost targets. Suggest a two-track pass: general-gen and embedding-heavy. For embeddings accept slightly higher mem but require throughput >= 400 qps on dedicated small.

maya: Good call. Also adding a compatibility check: model must support stable sampling seed and deterministic embeddings for same input on same pinned version.

jordan: Rollback triggers we discussed earlier — can we be explicit? Proposed triggers: sudden >10% drop in eval score, >3x increase in error rate, or sustained latency regression >2x baseline for 5m. Flags to auto-fall back to previous pinned model.

kevin: +1. Add a dataset-level guard: if a monitored prompt set shows >8% semantic shift (we detect via embeddings drift) then block rollout.

samir: Ops-bot can implement automated rollbacks for infra signals (OOMs, kernel panics). ops-bot, can we get a minimal webhook that accepts: `signal_type`, `severity`, `affected_model`, `current_version`?

ops-bot: @samir yes — webhook template created: POST /hooks/cat-events with JSON {"signal_type","severity","model","version","meta"}. Will wire to canary policy.

anas: For customer-driven asks: we need an opt-in migration window with explicit SLA adjustments. Customers can pin older version for 30 days after migration start. Also provide a lightweight shim for API changes (response shape) for 2 releases.

maya: We should also require a rollout plan doc attached to the catalog entry: intended canary %, metrics to watch, rollback steps, contact oncall. Make that a gating artifact.

jordan: Agreed. Action items: kevin to finalize numeric thresholds by EOD Wed; samir to publish webhook spec; maya to add 'rollout plan' field to catalog schema and mark as required for new entries; anas to add embedding/throughput track. I'll collate and ship the PR.

kevin: I’ll draft thresholds and a short runbook for canary -> ramp -> full policy. Will include a sample `canary.yaml`.

samir: I’ll add ops tests to the pipeline so any model PR runs the infra fingerprint checks automatically.

jordan: Thanks team. If no objections I’ll post the finalized checklist to #product-docs tomorrow and schedule a 20m sync with eng-runtime for rollout automation. :thumbsup:

maya: No objections from me. :+1:

kevin: no objections.

anas: ack.
